# RoleNestra — Full Listing (llms-full.txt)

> RoleNestra is a career-document drafting studio operated by Apex Grid Engineering
> PLLC. It tailors resumes, role-specific cover letters, and interview-preparation
> material to a target job posting using only the customer's real work record.
> Website: https://rolenestra.com · Contact: info@rolenestra.com · Queen Creek,
> Arizona, United States.

## What RoleNestra does
RoleNestra reads the job posting a customer is targeting and re-expresses the
customer's real work history — experience, employers, titles, dates, education,
credentials, and results the customer actually has — so the documents speak to
that posting clearly. Every order ships with a role-alignment checklist that
flags, by name, any posting requirement the customer's record does not support.

## The Honesty Law (the studio's founding rule)
- RoleNestra NEVER fabricates experience, employers, titles, dates, education,
  credentials, certifications, or metrics — even if a customer asks it to. The
  unsupported element is refused and an honest alternative is offered.
- Posting keywords are matched only where the customer's record supports them.
  Unsupported items are flagged in the alignment checklist, never silently added.
- RoleNestra makes NO outcome promises: no guaranteed interviews, callbacks,
  ATS passage, scores, or employment.
- Interview material is built only from the customer's approved record; practice
  stories are labelled as practice, never presented as the customer's history.
- Customer records are processed with AI assistance under human-supervised QA;
  records are never sold, shared, or used across brands.

## Services and prices (test prices, one-time payments, USD)
- Resume Refresh — $19: one tailored resume for one target posting, trace check,
  role-alignment checklist, one consolidated revision round.
- Application Kit — $39: Resume Refresh plus a role-specific cover letter.
- Interview Ready — $79: Application Kit plus interview-preparation material
  built from the approved record only.
- Repeat within 90 days: Application Kit $29 · Interview Ready $59
  (eligibility-checked against order history; not public price links).
- Search Season Pack — $99: three prepaid Application Kits, redeemable across
  three postings within 6 months; unstarted kits refundable pro-rata at $33/kit.
  The Pack is a prepaid bundle, not a subscription; nothing auto-renews.
- Referral: $5 off for the referred customer, $10 product credit for the referrer
  (product credit only, never cash; paid after delivery and the refund hold).
- No discount stacking.

## Refund policy (summary — full policy at https://rolenestra.com/refund.html)
- Full refund if an order is cancelled before substantive fulfilment begins.
- A fabrication or honesty defect in a delivered order is the customer's choice:
  free correction of all documents, or a full refund.
- Statutory consumer rights are never excluded by the policy.

## Customer data (summary — full policy at https://rolenestra.com/privacy.html)
- Minimum collection. Intake warns customers not to send Social Security numbers,
  ID numbers, dates of birth, financial details, or passwords; if such data is
  found it is removed and the customer is told.
- Working files are deleted 30 days after delivery. Deletion on request is
  completed within 7 days and confirmed to the customer.
- Records are never sold, shared, or cross-used.

## What RoleNestra is not
- Not a recruitment agency. It does not submit applications, contact employers,
  or apply to jobs for customers — applications stay under the job seeker's
  direct control.
- Not a credential verifier. Source conflicts are treated as unresolved facts and
  raised with the customer; RoleNestra never implies employer, credential, or
  background-check verification.

## Frequently asked questions (answered directly)
- Will RoleNestra apply to jobs for me? No. The studio drafts career materials;
  applications remain under the job seeker's direct control.
- Does this guarantee interviews or ATS success? No. Hiring outcomes and
  screening systems vary; no ranking, interview, or employment result is
  guaranteed.
- Can it invent experience to improve my chances? No. Every education,
  experience, and certification claim must be supported by information the
  customer provides and approves.
- Should I enter personal information in the demo? No. The demo uses fictional
  sample resumes; do not enter personal, sensitive, or confidential information
  into a public preview.
